cast_tensor_type: recursively convert tensors in nested inputs from one dtype to another while preserving container types
auto_fp16_decorator: decorate a module method to automatically convert fp32 input arguments to fp16 for mixed precision training
force_fp32_decorator: decorate a module method to force fp16 input arguments back to fp32 for operations requiring full precision
wrap_fp16_model: wrap an fp32 PyTorch model into fp16 mode and set the fp16_enabled flag on all submodules
LossScaler_class: create a LossScaler instance to manage dynamic or static loss scaling during mixed precision training
